text:
mia_cs: Heads-up — ACME dedicated capacity onboarding gate review. Need final signoff on quota numbers, autoscale policy, and the load-test window so we can flip the allocation on Tue.
raj_reliability: Quick notes from my side: customer expects ~600 concurrent conversational sessions steady, with short bursts up to ~2k. Recommend target throughput: 10k tokens/s steady, 30k tokens/s burst. Can we confirm operator-level quotas (per-minute token cap) before schedule?
kai_sre: Proposed autoscale profile: min=8 GPUs, desired=16, max=24 (A100s). Scale-up: GPU util >70% sustained for 90s; scale-up step +4 GPUs. Scale-down: util <40% for 5m; step -2 GPUs. Also enable burst pool (cold spare) for immediate headroom.
olivia_sales: ACME product team prefers Tue 03:00 UTC maintenance window. They asked for a short dry-run beforehand and real-time dashboard access during the test. I can get PM and infra contacts on the call.
mia_cs: Draft load-test plan — smoke at 02:00 UTC, prefix warmup + KV cache priming 02:45 UTC, full ramp 03:15–03:45 UTC, soak 03:45–04:00 UTC. Load profile attached (k6/locust style). Small snippet:
```
// warmup loop
for (i=0;i<1000;i++) fetch('/v1/generate', {body: prompt, headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer $TOKEN'}})
```
raj_reliability: I'll own the smoke run and quick latency/99 checks at 02:00. For the full run I'll collect: p50/p95/p99 latencies, GPU util, per-model token rate, and error rates by route.
kai_sre: Important: run KV cache priming before ramp. Command to prime prefixes:
```
./prime_prefixes --model rdx-7b --prompts-file acme_warmup.json --concurrency 50
```
Also add a failover policy in the routing layer to fallback to quantized variant if token queue grows > 2000.
olivia_sales: I'll create the conference bridge and add ACME infra lead @carlos_acme. Carlos, can you confirm someone will be on-call at 03:00?
carlos_acme: cmon it: I'll be there. We'll also toggle their internal rate limiter to allow the higher token rate for the window.
mia_cs: Checklist before go: 1) Quota commit confirmed (raj) 2) Autoscale policy applied (kai) 3) Runbook link and dashboard share (olivia) 4) KV priming script tested (raj) 5) Post-run regression evals scheduled (me). Please reply with :thumbsup: when done.
raj_reliability: Confirmed quotas and I'll post the token-cap table in this thread by EOD PST.
kai_sre: Applied autoscale policy to staging cluster. Will propagate to dedicated pool at 01:30 UTC and verify hooks.
deploy-bot: pipeline:release/dedicated-policy-sync triggered by kai_sre at 2026-03-21T00:20:11Z — status: queued
olivia_sales: Dashboard invite sent to ACME team and ops. Bridge scheduled 02:50 UTC.
mia_cs: Final signoffs? (raj, kai, olivia) — want to lock the window by EOD today.
raj_reliability: :thumbsup:
kai_sre: :thumbsup: will watch autoscale metrics during ramp.
olivia_sales: :thumbsup: ACME aligned.
mia_cs: Thanks — will post the postmortem template link and designate follow-up owner after the run.
